recent_reviews.content: Mcafee has come pre-downloaded on the last few laptops I've gotten. It is worse than a computer virus itself. It sends so many pop-ups asking you to renew your protection! Hackers are trying to steal...
recent_reviews.title: Worse than a computer virus
recent_reviews.suggested_reply: Hi Jay, we're sorry to hear that McAfee is negatively impacting your experience with excessive pop-ups. We understand how frustrating that can be. You can reduce these notifications by opening McAfee, going to Settings → General, and turning off "Product announcements." If you'd like further assistance with customizing your notification settings or have other concerns, please reach out to our support team at mcafee.com/support or call 1-866-622-3911. We appreciate your patience and want to help make things right.
